name: session_snapshot
description: Retrieve the full current state of the Bitwig Studio session. Returns transport state (playing, tempo, position), all tracks (name, volume, pan, mute, solo, arm), master track, clip grid (64 tracks x 8 slots with content, playback, and recording states), scenes, device state (cursor track, cursor device, remote control parameters), application state (project name, undo/redo), arranger state (7 visibility toggles), and arrangement state (loop range, punch in/out, automation mode, cue markers). Always call this before taking actions to understand the current state, and after actions to verify results.

name: api_list
description: List all available JSON-RPC methods registered in the Gig Maestro extension. Returns an array of method name strings. Useful for discovering available capabilities.

name: transport_play
description: Start playback in Bitwig Studio. If already playing, this has no effect.

name: transport_stop
description: Stop playback in Bitwig Studio. If already stopped, this has no effect.

name: transport_record
description: Toggle recording in Bitwig Studio. Arms the arranger record button.

name: transport_togglePlay
description: Toggle between play and stop states. If playing, stops; if stopped, plays.

name: transport_rewind
description: Rewind the transport position. Moves the playhead backward.

name: transport_fastForward
description: Fast-forward the transport position. Moves the playhead forward.

name: transport_tapTempo
description: Tap tempo. Each call registers a tap; Bitwig calculates the tempo from the tap interval.

name: transport_setTempo
description: Set the project tempo in BPM. Value is raw BPM (e.g., 120.0 for 120 BPM), not normalized.

tempo.description: Tempo in BPM (e.g., 120.0). Raw value, not normalized.

name: transport_setPosition
description: Set the transport playhead position in beats. Beat 0.0 is the project start.

beats.description: Position in beats from project start (e.g., 4.0 for beat 5, since 0-based).

name: transport_setLoop
description: Enable or disable the arranger loop in Bitwig Studio.

enabled.description: True to enable looping, false to disable.

name: transport_setMetronome
description: Enable or disable the metronome click in Bitwig Studio.

enabled.description: True to enable the metronome, false to disable.

name: app_undo
description: Undo the last action in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_redo
description: Redo the last undone action in Bitwig Studio.

name: app_getState
description: Get application state including the project name, and whether undo/redo are available. Returns an object with projectName, canUndo, canRedo, and hasActiveEngine.

name: track_setVolume
description: Set the volume of a track in the track bank. Volume is normalized 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = -inf dB, 1.0 = max).

name: track_setPan
description: Set the pan of a track in the track bank. Pan is normalized 0.0 (full left) to 1.0 (full right), with 0.5 as center.

value.description: Pan position, normalized 0.0 (left) to 1.0 (right). 0.5 is center.

name: track_setMute
description: Mute or unmute a track in the track bank.

muted.description: True to mute the track, false to unmute.

name: track_setSolo
description: Solo or unsolo a track in the track bank.

soloed.description: True to solo the track, false to unsolo.

name: track_setArm
description: Arm or disarm a track for recording in the track bank.

armed.description: True to arm the track for recording, false to disarm.

name: master_setVolume
description: Set the master track volume. Volume is normalized 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = -inf dB, 1.0 = max).

name: master_setPan
description: Set the master track pan. Pan is normalized 0.0 (full left) to 1.0 (full right), with 0.5 as center.

value.description: Pan position, normalized 0.0 (left) to 1.0 (right). 0.5 is center.

name: clip_launch
description: Launch a clip in the clip launcher. The clip at the specified track and slot index will start playing. Note: this starts the transport if it is currently stopped.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_stop
description: Stop all clips on a track. Stops any playing or recording clip on the specified track.

name: clip_record
description: Start recording into a clip slot. The track should be armed for recording first.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_create
description: Create an empty clip in a clip launcher slot. The clip will have the specified length in beats and can then be launched or recorded into.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

lengthInBeats.description: Length of the new clip in beats (e.g., 4 for one bar at 4/4).

name: scene_launch
description: Launch a scene in the clip launcher. Triggers all clips in the scene row across all tracks.

name: device_selectNext
description: Select the next device in the current track's device chain. The cursor device moves to the next device.

name: device_selectPrevious
description: Select the previous device in the current track's device chain. The cursor device moves to the previous device.

name: device_setEnabled
description: Enable or disable (bypass) the currently selected device.

enabled.description: True to enable the device, false to bypass it.

name: device_selectPage
description: Select a specific remote controls parameter page by index on the currently selected device.

index.description: Parameter page index (0-based). Check session_snapshot for pageCount.

name: device_nextPage
description: Navigate to the next remote controls parameter page on the currently selected device.

name: device_previousPage
description: Navigate to the previous remote controls parameter page on the currently selected device.

name: device_setParameterValue
description: Set a remote control parameter value on the currently selected device's current parameter page. Value is normalized 0.0 to 1.0.

index.description: Parameter index on the current page (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: cursor_selectTrack
description: Navigate the cursor track selection to the next or previous track sequentially. The cursor track follows the UI selection and determines which track's devices are shown. For direct index access, use `track_select` instead.

direction.description: Direction to move the cursor: 'next' for the track below, 'previous' for the track above.

name: clip_delete
description: Delete a clip from a clip launcher slot. Removes the clip and its contents entirely.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_select
description: Select a clip slot for note editing. The cursor clip will follow this selection, making it the target for setNotes, getNotes, clearNote, and clearAllNotes. Must be called before editing notes in a specific clip.

slotIndex.description: Clip slot index (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 7.

name: clip_setNotes
description: Write multiple notes into the selected clip in a single batch operation. Each note is placed at a grid position (x=step, y=MIDI note). Existing notes at the same positions are overwritten. Use this to write entire patterns, chords, basslines, or drum sequences in one call.

notes.description: Array of notes to write. Each note has x (step position), y (MIDI note number), velocity (0.0-1.0, optional, default ~0.79), and duration (in beats, optional, default 0.25).

x.description: Step position in the grid (0-based). At 1/16 resolution: 0-15 = bar 1, 16-31 = bar 2, etc.

y.description: MIDI note number (0-127). Common values: 36=C2 (kick), 38=D2 (snare), 42=F#2 (hi-hat), 60=C4 (middle C).

velocity.description: Note velocity, 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (maximum). Optional, defaults to ~0.79.

duration.description: Note duration in beats. 0.25 = 1/16 note, 0.5 = 1/8 note, 1.0 = 1/4 note. Optional, defaults to 0.25.

name: clip_clearNote
description: Remove a single note at the specified grid position in the selected clip.

name: clip_clearAllNotes
description: Remove all notes from the selected clip. This clears the entire clip content.

name: clip_getNotes
description: Read all notes in the selected clip's current grid viewport. Returns a sparse array containing only cells with notes (NoteOn state). Each note includes x (step), y (MIDI note), velocity (0.0-1.0), and duration (beats). Use this to inspect clip content before or after editing.

name: clip_setStepSize
description: Set the step grid resolution for the cursor clip. This determines the time duration of each step in the grid. Common values: 0.25 = 1/16 note (default), 0.5 = 1/8 note, 1.0 = 1/4 note, 0.125 = 1/32 note.

name: clip_scrollSteps
description: Scroll the step grid viewport to a specific step offset. The grid viewport is 64 steps wide. Use this to navigate to different sections of clips longer than 64 steps. Offset 0 = beginning, 64 = second page, etc.

offset.description: Step offset to scroll to (0-based). The viewport will show 64 steps starting from this position.

name: device_insertBitwigDevice
description: Insert a built-in Bitwig device onto the cursor track by name. The name is resolved case-insensitively from the Bitwig device library (151 devices). If the name is not found, an error is returned with close-match suggestions. Use `device_listBitwigDevices` to discover available devices first.

position.description: Where to insert: "end" = end of device chain (default), "before" = before cursor device, "after" = after cursor device.

name: device_insertPluginDevice
description: Insert a third-party plugin (VST2, VST3, or CLAP) onto the cursor track. You must know the plugin ID — VST2 uses integer IDs, VST3 and CLAP use string IDs.

id.description: Plugin ID. For VST2: integer as string (e.g., "1234567890"). For VST3/CLAP: string ID.

position.description: Where to insert: "end" = end of device chain (default), "before" = before cursor device, "after" = after cursor device.

name: device_listBitwigDevices
description: List all available built-in Bitwig devices. Returns a sorted array of device names that can be used with `device_insertBitwigDevice`. Includes instruments (Polymer, Poly Grid, FM-4, etc.), audio effects (EQ-5, Compressor, Delay-2, etc.), and note effects (Arpeggiator, Note Echo, etc.).

name: device_remove
description: Remove the currently selected device from the cursor track's device chain. Navigate to the target device first using `device_selectNext` / `device_selectPrevious`, then call this to delete it. Warning: the cursor device loses selection after removal — call `session_snapshot` to verify state. This action cannot be undone via this API (but Bitwig's undo may work).

name: track_createAudio
description: Create a new audio track in the project. Audio tracks can record and play audio clips. The new track is created at the specified position, or appended at the end if no position is given. The cursor track will follow the new track. Note: cursorTrackName in the response may lag — call `session_snapshot` to verify.

position.description: Insert position (0-based track index). Use -1 to append at the end (default).

name: track_createInstrument
description: Create a new instrument track in the project. Instrument tracks host virtual instruments and can record/play MIDI. The new track is created at the specified position, or appended at the end if no position is given. The cursor track will follow the new track. Note: cursorTrackName in the response may lag — call `session_snapshot` to verify.

position.description: Insert position (0-based track index). Use -1 to append at the end (default).

name: track_createEffect
description: Create a new effect track (return/bus track) in the project. Effect tracks receive audio from sends and apply effects. The new track is created at the specified position, or appended at the end if no position is given. The cursor track will follow the new track. Note: cursorTrackName in the response may lag — call `session_snapshot` to verify.

position.description: Insert position (0-based track index). Use -1 to append at the end (default).

name: track_select
description: Select a track by its bank index. The cursor track will follow this selection, making subsequent cursor-based operations (rename, delete, insert device, note editing) target the selected track. Index must be in the range 0–63. Out-of-range indices return an error with bank width context.

index.description: Track index to select (0-based). Valid range: 0 to 63.

name: track_rename
description: Rename the currently selected (cursor) track. The cursor track must be pointing at the desired track first — use `track_select` or `cursor_selectTrack` to navigate.

name: track_deleteSelected
description: Delete the currently selected (cursor) track from the project. This permanently removes the track and all its clips, devices, and automation. The cursor track must be pointing at the track to delete. Use `track_select` to target a specific track first.

name: track_duplicate
description: Duplicate the currently selected (cursor) track. Creates a copy of the track with all its clips, devices, and settings. The cursor track must be pointing at the track to duplicate.

name: arranger_setPlaybackFollow
description: Enable or disable playback follow in the arranger. When enabled, the arranger view scrolls to follow the playhead during playback.

enabled.description: True to enable playback follow, false to disable.

name: arranger_setClipLauncherVisible
description: Show or hide the clip launcher panel in the arranger view.

enabled.description: True to show the clip launcher, false to hide.

name: arranger_setTimelineVisible
description: Show or hide the arranger timeline. The timeline displays clips arranged linearly for song composition.

enabled.description: True to show the timeline, false to hide.

name: arranger_setCueMarkersVisible
description: Show or hide cue markers in the arranger timeline. Cue markers mark positions in the arrangement (intro, verse, chorus, etc.).

enabled.description: True to show cue markers, false to hide.

name: arranger_setEffectTracksVisible
description: Show or hide effect (return/bus) tracks in the arranger view.

enabled.description: True to show effect tracks, false to hide.

name: arranger_setIoSectionVisible
description: Show or hide the I/O section in the arranger. The I/O section shows input/output routing for each track.

enabled.description: True to show the I/O section, false to hide.

name: arranger_setDoubleRowTrackHeight
description: Toggle double-row track height in the arranger. When enabled, tracks display at double height for better visibility.

enabled.description: True for double-row height, false for single-row.

name: transport_setLoopRange
description: Set the arranger loop range and enable/disable looping. Defines a loop region by start position and duration in beats (quarter notes). Use with `transport_setPosition` to position playback at loop start.

start.description: Loop start position in beats (quarter notes). 0.0 = bar 1 beat 1.

duration.description: Loop duration in beats (quarter notes). e.g. 16.0 = 4 bars in 4/4.

enabled.description: True to enable looping, false to disable.

name: transport_getLoopRange
description: Get the current loop range, punch in/out positions, and their enabled states. Returns loopStart, loopDuration, loopEnabled, punchInPosition, punchInEnabled, punchOutPosition, punchOutEnabled.

name: transport_setPunchIn
description: Set the punch-in position and enable/disable punch-in recording. When enabled, recording only starts at the punch-in position.

enabled.description: True to enable punch-in, false to disable.

name: transport_setPunchOut
description: Set the punch-out position and enable/disable punch-out recording. When enabled, recording automatically stops at the punch-out position.

enabled.description: True to enable punch-out, false to disable.

name: transport_setAutomationWriteMode
description: Set the automation write mode. Controls how parameter changes are recorded as automation. 'latch' records from first touch until stop, 'touch' records only while touching and returns to existing automation on release, 'write' overwrites all automation in the played range.

mode.description: Automation write mode: latch, touch, or write.

name: transport_setArrangerAutomationWrite
description: Enable or disable automation writing in the arranger. When enabled, parameter changes during playback are recorded as arranger automation.

enabled.description: True to enable arranger automation write, false to disable.

name: transport_setClipLauncherAutomationWrite
description: Enable or disable automation writing in the clip launcher. When enabled, parameter changes during clip playback are recorded as clip automation.

enabled.description: True to enable clip launcher automation write, false to disable.

name: transport_resetAutomationOverrides
description: Reset all automation overrides. Clears any manual parameter adjustments made during playback, returning all automated parameters to their stored automation values.

name: cueMarker_addAtPlayhead
description: Add a cue marker at the current playhead position. To place a marker at a specific beat, first use `transport_setPosition` to move the playhead, then call this. Cue markers are used to label arrangement sections (intro, verse, chorus, etc.).

name: cueMarker_list
description: List all cue markers in the 16-slot cue marker bank. Returns an array of existing markers with index, name, position (in beats), and color (RGB array). Empty slots are omitted.

name: cueMarker_launch
description: Launch playback from a cue marker position. Moves the playhead to the marker and starts playback. Use `cueMarker_list` first to find valid marker indices.

index.description: Cue marker index (0-15) from the marker bank.

quantized.description: If true, launch is quantized to the grid. If false, launches immediately. Defaults to false.

name: cueMarker_delete
description: Delete a cue marker by its bank index. Use `cueMarker_list` first to find the marker index to delete.
